Then, you have to practice lines (drift pattern) and NISC.
 
In order to know how to do these NISCs properly, you need to know that it is when the back wheels hit the grass that you can lose your drift. So, to have a good NISC, you have to release your finger just before your back wheels touch the grass, it's the best cue. It sounds simple, but you have to know that the older players also had trouble at the beginning and it's with practice and training that it came!
